citations.assessment: The internal article explicitly recounts his prayer for Mani’s wife and identifies Mani as Yonah’s son.
The separate Yonah article cites the rain and son episodes from the same Ta’anit folio.
The Bavli connects Mani with Yitzḥak ben Elyashiv and gives the entire episode with Ḥannah. Its report both grants and reverses the change in her appearance.

The wine jar dispute is in digital 4:6:4. It gives Mana and unqualified Yose, and includes the title R. in the barrel legend. Retain Heilprin’s deliberate bare legend and fuller Yose patronymic as his report.
